# Freedom with AI

> Freedom with AI accelerates entrepreneurs building in space and physical AI. Build. Advise. Invest. Sonia Sarao leads advisory. Cammie Clay leads investing.

Advisory is space-led, and also open to physical AI, deep-tech, FinTech, B2B software and life sciences founders. Investing focuses on early-stage space companies, and physical AI where it meets space.

## Thesis

[Thesis](https://freedomwith.ai/thesis): AI is leaving the screen. The money moved from software (bits) into chips, data centers and power (bits buy atoms), and next into machines that act in the world (bits drive atoms). Space is the whole AI stack under its hardest constraints: energy, chips, infrastructure, models and applications, each with less power, bandwidth and room for error. Freedom with AI works at the company-building layer, helping founders turn technical capability into a product, a market and a durable business. The five-layer stack builds on Jensen Huang's framing of AI as infrastructure.

[State of AI: Investing](https://freedomwith.ai/thesis/state-of-ai-investing): Cammie Clay's October 2026 talk following the money from software to the real world.

## Advisory

[Advisory](https://freedomwith.ai/advisory) with Sonia Sarao is space-led, with the deepest focus on in-space servicing, assembly and manufacturing (ISAM). It covers finding the market, building the product and company, selling into complex buyers, and raising and diligence. Engagements begin with a three- or six-month term.

## Investing

[Investing](https://freedomwith.ai/investing): early, small checks of the firm's own capital, alongside specialist investors where deep aerospace or hardware diligence is needed. Advisory and investment decisions are separate.

## Partners

- Sonia Sarao, Co-founder, Advisory: 20+ years in enterprise software and financial-market infrastructure, including a decade at NYSE. Led product at Groove through its acquisition by Clari; first product hire at Fluxx, later VP of Product and Engineering. Brings software, product and commercial experience, not aerospace engineering. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/sonia-sarao/
- Cammie Clay, Co-founder, Investing: seasoned trader and public markets investor. Formerly a regulator at the New York Stock Exchange and FINRA, then a compliance executive at RS Investments and First Republic Bank. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/cammieclay/
